summary: Closure review: the study is artifact‑grounded and internally consistent, but required publication edits remain. The References section has not been converted to a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography using the archived terminal_bibliographic_records, and the Disclosure Statement remains too long and includes execution/accounting bookkeeping that must be removed. A brief, explicit confirmatory‑vs‑exploratory paragraph in Results/Discussion must be tightened to the requested concise form. Until these three required revisions are addressed in the manuscript text, the paper is not ready for finalisation.
critical_issues: References are not presented as a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography built from the archived terminal_bibliographic_records; several citation entries/identifiers remain in non‑bibliographic or identifier‑only form rather than full IEEE entries with authors, title, venue, year, and DOI/URL.

Disclosure Statement in the manuscript is overly long and includes execution/accounting details, per‑episode logs, artifact paths, model‑call counts, and other archived bookkeeping that must be removed from the paper body; only the mandatory disclosure items (model(s)+provider(s); orchestration/validator names; immutable initial master prompt locator + exact SHA‑256; preregistration identifier and statement it was frozen prior to model calls; and affirmation that no human manually edited technical manuscript content after the autonomy lock) should remain in a single concise paragraph. All other provenance and accounting belong in the archived evidence bundle.

The prior required short confirmatory statement in Results/Discussion (preregistered exact two‑sided McNemar is the confirmatory analysis and did not reach two‑sided α=0.05; bootstrap CI and any one‑sided tests are descriptive/exploratory) must be present as a tightened concise paragraph (≤3 sentences) that also briefly explains why the paired bootstrap CI may exclude zero under extremely sparse discordant counts (referencing the archived contingency table and bootstrap seed). The current manuscript includes the information but it must be tightened to the requested concise form.
required_revisions: Replace the References section with a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography constructed from the archived terminal_bibliographic_records. For each cited record include authors, full title, venue/repository, year, and DOI or URL when available; do not leave bare DOI/arXiv/OpenAlex identifier entries. Ensure in‑text citations use IEEE numeric markers that match the new bibliography.

Condense the Disclosure Statement to a single concise paragraph (within the five‑page manuscript) that contains only the mandatory items: declared model(s) and provider(s); orchestration/validator names (hosted_netops_gvr_v1 and deterministic_netops_validator_v5); the immutable initial master prompt locator and exact SHA‑256 (provenance/master_prompt.txt : 1872df1e1805d2d96940456ca016bd665d1d5196add77f5acdf1582bb39b15ba); the preregistration identifier (cand‑003‑stud‑001) and an explicit statement that it was frozen prior to any model calls; and an affirmation that no human manually edited the manuscript technical content after the autonomy lock. Remove execution/accounting numbers, per‑episode logs, artifact paths, cache/model‑call counts, detailed artifact hashes, and other archived bookkeeping from the Disclosure text (these remain acceptable in the archived evidence bundle).

Add or tighten one concise paragraph (≤3 sentences) in the Results or Discussion that plainly states the inferential hierarchy: the preregistered exact two‑sided McNemar is the confirmatory test and did not reach two‑sided α=0.05 (p=0.0625); the paired bootstrap CI and any one‑sided McNemar reported are descriptive/exploratory and do not overturn the preregistered confirmatory null. In the same paragraph include one short clause explaining why the preregistered paired bootstrap CI may exclude zero with extremely sparse discordant counts (cite the archived 2×2 contingency table and bootstrap seed/artifacts).
optional_revisions: Optionally include a compact table or boxed appendix listing the five discordant pair IDs and brief failure reason codes (from terminal_factual_accounting) to illustrate repair modes; this is permitted but not required and must fit within the five‑page limit if included.

Optionally add one short sentence in Threats to Validity discussing whether the observed very high baseline validity likely arises from generator behavior, corpus characteristics, or validator permissiveness, and point readers to the archived artifacts for adjudication.
